dashboard.label: Service Glass Table
dashboard.description: Live topology wall - every tile reads the SAME reachability signal as its ITSI KPI (central port probes + UF heartbeats), so the glass table and the Service Analyzer always agree. 100% = reachable (green), 0% = down (red).

div.div: ● reachable (100%) ● down (0%) · last 15 min · click a tile → Root Cause Analysis

html.p: Every tile reads the same signal as its ITSI KPI - central port probes (containers, hypervisor, routers) and UF heartbeats (Ubuntu, Splunk) - so this wall and the ITSI Service Analyzer move together. Rollups (Directory App, Berlin, London, Global) are red if any child is down. Run demo-chaos.sh break-db and watch Database Service → Directory App → Berlin → Global cascade to red in ~1-2 min; recover brings them back. Click any tile for Root Cause Analysis.
